# Why did my Square item import fail?

> Free Square item library CSV checker: finds repeated or damaged Tokens, duplicate SKUs and variation names, bad prices, Y/N flags, wrong GTIN check digits, Excel-damaged SKUs and semicolon files, with line numbers, and applies safe fixes. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
